Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, straightforward intro page that makes it easy to find your contact details. Overall, a clean and professional starting point with room to grow!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). The hiking mention is a great hook — outdoor adventure is a compelling theme for a blog. Right now the page is very brief, so adding actual posts (e.g., hiking routes, gear reviews, trip reports), a short personal introduction, and photos from your trails would make it much more engaging and help readers follow your adventures. I'd love to read more about your hiking experiences!
